name: Potion of Experience is only for alts below the account's highest level
contract: For a CoA class character (Resilient Constitution 552011), the Potion of Experience (818046) tooltip states: This item can only be used on alt characters who are not the highest level on your account. A level 20 character whose only other character is level 10 is refused and keeps the potion. Once the other character is saved at level 30, the same character drinks one potion and receives aura 818046.

steps.label: The highest character on the account cannot drink the potion
The refusal answers SPELL_FAILED_DONT_REPORT beside the tooltip text
A higher character on the account lets the alt drink the potion
